articles.headline: Bulls roll to a 137-107 victory over the Nets in their easiest win of the season
articles.description: — Matas Buzelis scored a season-high 25 points, Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists, and the Chicago Bulls rolled to their easiest victory of the season by beating the Brooklyn Nets 137-107 on Wednesday night.
